Global Language Standards

CEFR Level Progression & Mastery Roadmap

Structured learning outcomes, vocabulary milestones, and real-world communication capabilities aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

A1 Breakthrough ⏱️ 40 Hours

Target Vocabulary: ~800 words

  • ✔️ Understand & use daily familiar expressions
  • ✔️ Introduce yourself & ask basic personal questions
  • ✔️ Interact in a simple way if the person speaks slowly
A2 Waystage ⏱️ 50 Hours

Target Vocabulary: ~1,600 words

  • ✔️ Understand sentences on immediate relevance (family, shopping, geography)
  • ✔️ Handle routine tasks requiring simple, direct exchange of information
  • ✔️ Describe background, immediate environment, and immediate needs
B1 Threshold ⏱️ 60 Hours

Target Vocabulary: ~3,200 words

  • ✔️ Understand main points of clear standard input on familiar matters
  • ✔️ Deal with most situations while traveling in a language region
  • ✔️ Produce simple connected text on topics of personal interest
B2 Vantage 🇨🇦 ⏱️ 60 Hours

Target Vocabulary: ~5,000+ words

  • ✔️ Understand complex text on concrete & abstract topics
  • ✔️ Interact with native speakers with degree of fluency & spontaneity
  • ✔️ Achieve TEF Canada NCLC 7 benchmark (+50 CRS Points!)
TEF / DELF Master Guide

TEF Canada Examination Structure

Detailed breakdown of the 4 mandatory test components for Canadian Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs.

🎧

Compréhension Orale (Listening)

40 Questions • 40 Minutes
Audio clips covering phone messages, radio announcements, news broadcasts, and casual conversations.

📖

Compréhension Écrite (Reading)

40 Questions • 60 Minutes
Articles, public notices, graphs, corporate emails, and complex literary or technical texts.

🗣️

Expression Orale (Speaking)

2 Formal Tasks • 15 Minutes
Task A: Gathering information on an ad. Task B: Persuading an examiner on a controversial proposal.

✍️

Expression Écrite (Writing)

2 Writing Tasks • 60 Minutes
Task A: Writing a newspaper article report. Task B: Formal letter expressing and justifying your opinion.

Frequently Asked Questions

Language Ark Learning FAQ

Everything you need to know about batch sizes, certification validity, and course schedules.

We strictly cap our batch sizes at 8 to 10 students. Small batch sizes ensure personalized oral speaking practice, live feedback from certified master instructors, and interactive peer debates during every session.
All classes at Language Ark are 100% Live & Interactive via Zoom / Google Meet. Students engage in real-time conversation drills, pronunciation corrections, and breakout room simulations. Session recordings and class notes are also uploaded after every class.
Under Canada Express Entry, candidates who achieve NCLC 7 (CLB 7) or higher in French (TEF Canada or TCF Canada) receive up to +50 additional bonus points for bilingualism, plus up to +24 skill transferability points, giving a total score boost of up to 74 points!
Official diplomas like DELF (French), DELE (Spanish), and Goethe (German) have LIFETIME validity. Language proficiency tests for immigration such as TEF Canada are valid for 2 years from the test date.
Yes! You can click the Book Demo button in the navbar or connect on WhatsApp at +91 7758929852 to schedule a free 1-on-1 consultation and live trial demo session with our Academic Head.

10-D Dossier Breakdown

The ACCDS™ 10 Dimensions of Discovery

Covering all evaluation modules from Page 06 to Page 70 of the Astral Academy™ Student Workbook.

PAGE 06

🧠 Personality Assessment

Evaluates introversion vs extroversion, emotional resilience, openness to experience, and working style.

PAGE 12

🔍 Career Interests (RIASEC)

Holland interest code measuring Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, and Conventional traits.

PAGE 18

📖 Learning Style & Preferences

Visual, Auditory, and Kinesthetic (VAK) learning preferences for optimal study retention.

PAGE 22

🧠 Multiple Intelligences

Identifies Howard Gardner's 8 intelligence vectors (Linguistic, Spatial, Mathematical, Interpersonal, etc.).

PAGE 28

❤️ Emotional Intelligence (EQ)

Measures emotional regulation, empathy, stress tolerance, and social relationship management.

PAGE 33

👥 Leadership & Teamwork

Evaluates team role tendencies (Coordinator, Implementer, Shaper) and group synergy dynamics.

PAGE 38

📖 Study Habits & Discipline

Diagnoses time management, distraction triggers, exam preparation discipline, and revision routines.

PAGE 43

🎯 Decision Making & Motivation

Uncovers intrinsic vs extrinsic motivators and cognitive decision-making patterns under pressure.

PAGE 48

📐 Aptitude Battery (Verbal & Numerical)

Psychometric testing across Verbal Comprehension, Numerical Logic, and Spatial Reasoning.

PAGE 70

⛳ My Career Action Plan

A customized 5-year academic roadmap detailing Class 11 stream selection and college entrance strategies.

Astral Career Counselling FAQ

Everything parents and students need to know about the ACCDS™ evaluation dossier and debrief sessions.
